legend: One of the most useful tools nowadays are text editors, their use is so important that the Unique Natural Advanced Language (UNAL) organization has studied many of the benefits working with them.

They are interested specifically in the feature "find", that option looks when a pattern occurs in a text, furthermore, it counts the number of times the pattern occurs in a text. The tool is so well designed that while writing each character of the pattern it updates the number of times that the corresponding prefix of the total pattern appears on the text.

Now the UNAL is working with the editor, finding patterns in some texts, however, they realize that many of the patterns appear just very few times in the corresponding texts, as they really want to see more number of appearances of the patterns in the texts, they put a lower bound on the minimum number of times the pattern should be found in the text and use only prefixes of the original pattern. On the other hand, the UNAL is very picky about language, so they will just use the largest non-empty prefix of the original pattern that fit into the bound.
input: The first line contains the text A (1 ≤ |A| ≤  105) The second line contains the original pattern B (1 ≤ |B| ≤  |A|) The third line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤  |A|) - the minimum number of times a pattern should be found on the text.
output: A single line, with the prefix of the original pattern used by the UNAL, if there is no such prefix then print "IMPOSSIBLE" (without the quotes)

legend.ai: 如今，文本编辑器是最有用的工具之一，它们的重要性如此之高，以至于独特自然高级语言（Unique Natural Advanced Language，UNAL）组织研究了使用文本编辑器工作的诸多益处。
他们尤其感兴趣的是“查找”功能：该选项会查找模式串在文本中的出现情况，并且还会统计模式串在文本中出现的次数。这个工具设计得非常完善：在输入模式串的每个字符时，它都会更新整个模式串的相应前缀在文本中出现的次数。
现在，UNAL 正在使用该编辑器，在一些文本中查找模式串。然而，他们发现许多模式串在相应文本中只出现了很少几次。由于他们确实希望看到模式串在文本中出现得更多，他们规定了模式串在文本中出现次数的下界，并且只使用原模式串的前缀。另一方面，UNAL 对语言非常挑剔，因此他们只会使用原模式串中出现次数达到该下界的最长非空前缀。

input.ai: 第一行包含文本 A（1 ≤ |A| ≤ 10^5）。第二行包含原模式串 B（1 ≤ |B| ≤ |A|）。第三行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ |A|），表示模式串在文本中至少应出现的次数。

output.ai: 输出一行，即 UNAL 使用的原模式串的前缀；如果不存在这样的前缀，则输出“IMPOSSIBLE”（不含引号）。
